implemented_scenarios.coverage: Session- and request-scoped forms during initialize, newSession, authentication and prompt; retained responders after parent-RPC completion; exact original arithmetic effects.

All supported flat types, enum intersection, multiselect, defaults/unset/null distinctions, Unicode lengths, numeric bounds, malformed schemas, field/option/answer limits and explicit pattern/format limitations.
Exact offered allow/reject once/always options causally gate tool arithmetic; original-native allow and API deny share the same session.

API/original-native winners in both admission orders; losing selections excluded from accepted history; fresh interaction IDs prevent reused wire-ID rebinding; actual write failure and EOF remain distinct from application.

Atomic interrupt reservations; pending, already-selected and late form/permission handling; writer-capacity rejection; content/count exhaustion; bootstrap/auth forms excluded from prompt cancellation.
Distinct decline/cancel responses; exact protocol errors for unsupported schemas, URL/filesystem/terminal/unknown requests and invalid scopes.

interface_projection_notes: Existing Broker public signatures remain unchanged. Added pub(crate) fn validate_form_values(schema: &Value, values: &Value) -> std::result::Result<(), &'static str>.
Top-level interaction metadata remains content-free. Canonical details and retained selections are confined to content.interactions.
Form details expose message, official scope and requested-schema shape, plus validation_limitations. Request-scoped details expose scope_parent_state as outstanding, completed or unknown.
Permission details expose exact scope, official tool_call shape and options containing option_id, name and kind. Response binding preserves typed wire IDs and offered values.
Response-write completion uses bounded per-responder evidence so fast legal wire-ID reuse cannot race delayed writer bookkeeping or release a newer responder.
Retained interaction content is capped at 4 MiB, including selections. Completed-history eviction reports truncation.interactions and never evicts live responders.
Response work includes exact rpc_id and interaction_id; delivery remains separate from application. No shared-file changes or new dependencies were introduced.
Committed unsigned using command-local signing fallback; commit hooks were disabled to preserve the parent-only verification boundary.
remaining_uncertainties: Compilation, tests, lint, formatting and actual CLI/controlling-PTY behavior remain unverified pending parent integration.
OriginalNative regression coverage uses the original persistent registration/provenance path; it does not claim actual human PTY proof.
No acceptance ledger or scenario status was marked passing.
delivery.verify_output: intentionally not run; parent owns checks
